decisions.structure: CSharp retains concrete semantic BoundFunction specializations in ResolvedGenericCalls, recovers only an implicit receiver from lexical lookup, chooses emittable concrete functions and consumes their declared ReturnType/termination. Native publishes selected generic call types and owned payload flags, finalizes ordinary structure/calls/controls/bindings/return in order and seals merged literal/selection/producer identities before emission.
decisions.branches: Generic declaration versus concrete instance; exact semantic specialization versus receiver lookup; ordinary versus generated COM request; unresolved versus canonical result; terminal/all-path return versus continuing value; numeric/reference peers and exact transparent binding->wrapper->control source chain.
decisions.logic: FunctionLowerRequest is source/symbol identity, not a generated runtime body. publishGenericCallTypes updates the call from its selected instance then seals dependent payload/index/member identities. finalizeOrdinaryFunctionExpressions delegates existing ordered passes; sealResolvedContext finalizes canonical type/value edges. These are the actual typed-input provider responsibilities corresponding to CSharp concrete function/call/result consumption, not a claim that every helper in the large files has identical implementation.
decisions.diagnostics: CSharp throws if an all-path-return expression reaches a continuation or if canonical resolution is absent. Native preserves its existing checked unresolved/type and parent/root conditions. No new default, declaration fallback or skipped invariant. Current58 general regression proof is retained within its existing scope; no complete generic/control phase is newly executed.

decisions.structure: CSharp EmitFunctionCall/EmitFlowExpression retains BoundFunction metadata, dispatches Native to EmitNativeFunctionCall, then COM metadata to activation/clone/query/method; ordinary native calls retain status-out/aggregate/scalar return contracts. Native source lowering separates generated COM declarations, constructs canonical interface/Result/receiver IR from symbol metadata and normalizes declared runtime identities before final emission.
decisions.branches: COM activation/query Result versus clone/reference receiver; direct embedded native versus dynamically loaded target; status-out versus aggregate/scalar ABI remains an emission dependency. Late declared intrinsic classification requires a resolved physical declaration/module and the intrinsic flag; ordinary same-spelled user functions retain their call path. Display-only print aliases cannot replace sys.runtime worker intrinsic identities.
decisions.logic: normalizeResolvedContext runs ordered core/binding/pattern/control/runtime/contextual/late-binding passes and reclassifies declared/process operations after late binding. normalizeResolvedDeclaredRuntime and resolvedProcessRuntimeOpcode select the exact declaration, preserving source-module identity across namespace fragments. The registered responsibility is admission/type/call input to downstream codegen, not implementation of all runtime effects or operating-system ABI bodies.
decisions.diagnostics: Preserve CSharp missing COM metadata/unknown interface/argument/target checks, Native canonical type table and exact declaration/range guards, existing ownership flags and receiver mode. The checked display-alias source only aliases print/println; it does not erase the worker declaration during this normalizer. Full COM execution, live servers, all native ABI variants and target-platform behavior remain separate required acceptance.
